# enable

Enable a plugin processing step

## Usage

```
ppds plugins enable [options]
```

## Arguments

| Name | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `step-name-or-id` | yes | Step name or GUID to enable |

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--correlation-id` |  | `string` |  | Correlation ID for distributed tracing |
| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Show trace-level diagnostic output |
| `--environment` | `-env` | `string` |  | Override the environment URL. Takes precedence over profile's bound environment. |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--profile` | `-p` | `string` |  | Authentication profile name |
| `--quiet` | `-q` | `bool` |  | Show only warnings and errors |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `bool` |  | Show detailed output including debug messages |
